reply_text:
I did notice this on 10-11, with t96A07, but I only fixed the diagnostic for closure rows, not the mechanism itself. Next I'll measure how widespread it is and find where a stop becomes "done".The checker now rejects a stopped row marked "done", so the bad case is caught. Next I'll migrate the ledgers.I'm adding a regression test for the new state, then I'll run the loop test suite.㊥ (t00J07's row showed "done" though its job had stopped) I've fixed the mechanism this time, not just one row. When a reviewer accepted an honest stop, the loop tooling set the row to "done". Rows that depended on it then went ahead as if the work had been delivered, and the lemma it was elected to prove was marked proved. A reviewed stop now gets a separate state, `:stopped`, which doesn't satisfy anything. The ledgers are migrated, tests pass, and the loops are running again (`46edc9d54`, `c698123c8`).

🈹 (my 10-11 fix) You had flagged this before, on 10-11 with t96A07. I changed only the per-problem report to list stopped closure rows. I didn't touch the transition that marks them done, and I didn't check other kinds of row.

㊢ (how much it affected) Across the two older loops' ledgers (topo3's was clean):
- **Rows:** 190 rows were "done" although their job had stopped, 121 in topo1 and 69 in topo2. 156 other rows depended on them, and 144 of those had already gone ahead as done.
- **Lemmas:** 10 were marked proved although no such theorem exists anywhere in the repo. 4 are in t93J03's Klein-bottle chain and 3 are t99J01's leg-coordinate lemmas. Two more nearly matched by name, but the repo has only weaker versions with an extra assumption.
- **t00J07:** its row was waiting on a hemisphere trivialization that had only ever been written as a statement, with no proof.

㊢ (the fix)
- **New state:** accepting a stopped job now sets the row to `:stopped`. That doesn't unblock dependent rows or bank any lemma. Program rows still continue, and strategy checkpoints still go to the owner, as before.
- **Checkpoints and reopening:** strategy checkpoints treat a `:stopped` row like an owner-held one, so they still run and can pick up the work it named. A `:stopped` row also reopens automatically once a lemma it reported missing is proved.
- **Checker:** the ledger checker now rejects a row marked "done" whose job stopped. On the unmigrated ledgers it caught exactly these rows.
- **Strategy prompt:** it now says to read a `:stopped` row's reason and elect the work it names.

㊢ (migration)
- **Rows:** all 190 moved to `:stopped`. 3 reopened straight away, because the lemmas they were missing have since been proved.
- **Lemmas:** the 10 false ones went back to the to-do list.
- **Open rows:** one open row went back to blocked.
- **Checks:** all three ledgers pass the checker. The loop test suite passes, including a new test: a stop followed by an accepting review leaves the row `:stopped`, its lemma unproved and the row after it blocked.

㊟ (the t93J03 round now running) Its brief told codex-71 that the loops had banked 15 lemmas for it, and 4 of those were the false ones. codex-71 works from the actual Lean files, so this shouldn't mislead it. I've corrected the audit note, and I'll check this when the round reports.
